answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on strict entropy generation requirements tied to verifiable physical clock intervals. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The atlas holds work receipts rather than names, so the cipher of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
